sources.title: Qing Siku received 三命通會 卷七 子平說辯 historiographical lineage narrative
sources.provider: Wikisource Qing Siku received transcription of Ming work, non-original physical text
sources.quality_notes: Received 四庫 text v7 子平說辯 distinguishes 徐君易/徐居易 子平 from 徐大升, claims retrospective 李虛中/子平/冲虛子/道洪/大升 succession, but explicitly admits change after centuries and uses 或謂 for true transmission. No independent Five-Dynasties/Song-era original folio or 1578 first edition glyph. Shidian SK1610 rendering is only a comparison text, not separate ancient witness.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1578 Ming retrospective narrative alone does not confirm 5th-century Xu Ziping personal reality or independent Song teacher-to-disciple chain
1307 Li Qinfu colophon and 1326 Wang Zanzhong preface survive only in later Qing catalog report; neither is independent manuscript folio nor automatic evidence for received Yuanhai Ziping
same nominal Ziping school, day-stem focus, or source title does not establish exact lineage between 1228 Wuxing Jingji, 1307 annotation, 1578 Sanming Tonghui and 1600 Yuanhai printed family
unresolved_lineage_questions: Song/Yuan original colophon/afterword of 1307/1326 Ziping Sanming Yuanyuan Zhu
contemporaneous evidence for Xu Juyi, Chongxuzi, Daohong, Xu Dasheng and their exact text transmission
original 1578 Sanming Tonghui juan7 physical glyph vs Siku received text
dated original folio of 1600 Yuanhai technical rules as separate from retroactive founder narrative
